flags.reason: misreads-source: The evidence says one Enter calls `onValueChange(true)` once and one Space "calls it once", but for click it only says "Click is unchanged". It does not say click calls the callback exactly once, or with what value, so "called once with the new value for each Enter, Space or click" goes slightly beyond what the file records.
